gate._note: Ingest quality gate — docs/02-dataset-spec.md §6. Thresholds live here, not in code, so a gate change is a reviewable diff and is recorded verbatim in every data/ingest_report.json.

edge_density._note: Measured on the INTERIOR of the warped ROI only, with interior_margin_frac excluded per side. Counting the full frame lets an image with no pattern at all pass on its border alone.
